detonate FIRST calls native Level.explode(source=mortar,radius ordinary0.1 or mega4,fire=canEntityGrief(level,mortar),interaction=MOB); THEN loops entities in mortarBB.inflate(1) without owner exclusion or LOS. Finally discard regardless accepted HP damage. There is no separate on-collision18 hit before explosion:18 is the post-explosion nearby query, and ignores explosion exposure. Native explosion source is minecraft:player_explosion when direct mortar and Living indirect owner both exist (despite the type name, original Hydra owner qualifies), otherwise minecraft:explosion. The18 request is fire-tagged, NOT IS_EXPLOSION or IS_PROJECTILE and NOT armor bypass; Explosion Protection applies to preceding explosion, Fire Protection to the custom18, ordinary Protection/Resistance/absorption/cooldown remain. paths.source: Native head counter crossing and regrowth
paths.native_delivery: Each head has integer damageTaken, initially0; addDamage truncates each float request independently, never reads actual HP loss. Server AI schedules DYING only when !isDead and damageTaken>120 (strictly greater, not >=120), ends current action and sets respawnCounter140. It also picks one random current DEAD head whose counter==-1 and schedules140 if any; there is no eighth head. DYING counts as dead for attacks/hurt and active-count, but isActive means state!=DEAD, so DYING is saved as active. DYING lasts70; respawn countdown only decrements while current DEAD. A newly recruited already-DEAD head therefore starts its140 countdown immediately, while the killed head waits through DYING first. At --counter<=0, schedule BORN, reset damageTaken0, end current action and set counter-1. Then BORN20 -> ROAR_START10 -> ROAR_RAWR50 -> IDLE. No parent heal in head regrowth and no fire/cauterize predicate. All seven can ultimately be active. Bite remains restricted to head indexes0..2 and requires active-count>2; all heads can flame/mortar. Loss can reduce concurrency and suppress bites until regrowth; it is not an HP-threshold phase. Container server tick: tick head/necks; update difficulty; activate nondead zero-width parts or deactivate DEAD parts; advance respawn, then ++ticksProgress and transition when>=ticksNeeded, then position/facing/execute/sounds. A transition sets progress0, so attack runs on entry. Explicit pending next state wins automatic successor; endCurrentAction sets progress=ticksNeeded for next tick. Initial active IDLE uses60/60 (transitions next tick); enum IDLE duration10 thereafter. Durations: BITE_BEGINNING40 -> BITE_READY80 -> BITING7 -> BITE_ENDING40 -> ATTACK_COOLDOWN80 -> IDLE; FLAME_BEGINNING40 -> FLAMING100 -> FLAME_ENDING30 -> cooldown; MORTAR_BEGINNING40 -> MORTAR_SHOOTING25 -> MORTAR_ENDING30 -> cooldown; DYING70 -> DEAD20 loop; birth sequence as above. Secondary attacks replace automatic cooldown with IDLE and clear their flag. Mouth is clamped interpolation previous-state to current-state, not a binary attack flag: idle/cooldown/dead/born/ending0, flame/mortar beginning0.75 and active1, bite beginning0.25/ready1/biting0.2, roar-start0.25/roar1. Thus vulnerable >0.5 includes portions of windup/end/roar, not all attack ticks; for example BITING starts open and closes during seven ticks. Death marks head at1 and five necks at10/20/30/40/50, then each marked part deactivates at its deathTime20. Size/state/mouth/current+last and names are synced through existing multipart data; not independent health.

Head interpolated mouth openness strictly>0.5 forwards original amount; every other part/closed head forwards Math.round(amount/8F). Closed-head/body armor is this fixed pre-pipeline reduction, not armor attribute or a bypassable armor tag. Open-head counter adds (int)original amount; closed-head counter adds rounded amount, AFTER hurt regardless of its bool or actual HP. Admission rejects before forwarding add nothing. Native server/alive/fire-resistance/events/shield/cooldown/armor/Resistance/protection/absorption then decide HP. True alone resets ticksSinceDamaged.
